rationale.elig-residency: Eligibility §3.2 says 'Applicants must be an Australian citizen or have permanent residency status.'; p.3 confirms citizenship and Darwin residence.
rationale.elig-property: Eligibility §3.1.1 says 'applicants and tenants who own or partly own residential property anywhere in Australia are ineligible for social housing.'; p.4 declares no such interest.
rationale.elig-income: Identification and Documentation §3.2 says 'The CEO (Housing) requires evidence of income and assets to determine eligibility for social housing, private rental bond assistance, and to calculate rent.'; p.9 records current evidence received.
rationale.elig-debts: Eligibility §3.4 says 'The provision of social housing will not be withheld based on a debt owed to the CEO (Housing).'; p.8's debt does not cause the decline.
rationale.elig-former-tenancy: Eligibility §3.5 says 'An application will not be accepted until the 2-year period has expired.'; pp.1 and 7 show a breach termination only seven months before application.
rationale.prio-category: Priority §3 lists 'At risk of homelessness;' as urgent need; p.5 confirms that the temporary room is ending.
rationale.prio-documentation: Priority §3.1 says 'Applicants must prove their urgent need for priority housing and are required to provide documentation that supports their claim for priority.'; p.5 supplies independent support.
rationale.prio-discretion: Priority §3.1 allows 'some discretion for extreme situations'; pp.5 and 7 show ordinary homelessness with a recent breach termination, without an extreme-situation request.
